Recommended Change: Compress /og-image.jpg to <120 KB progressive JPEG/WebP (1200x630) with explicit og:image:width and og:image:height meta tags.
Ready-to-Apply Code:
<meta property="og:image" content="https://incubrix.com/og-image.jpg" />
<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200" />
<meta property="og:image:height" content="630" />
<meta property="og:image:alt" content="IncuBrix Creator Studio — Create With Purpose, Publish Without Limits" />
Validation Method: Verify candidate OG image metadata specifies og:image:width='1200', og:image:height='630', and non-empty og:image:alt.
Validation Result: OPEN ON LIVE SITE: No live fix detected on https://incubrix.com/og-image.jpg. | Candidate Patch Check: PASS: Validated Open Graph image dimensions (1200x630) and alt metadata.

Title: Pipe Character ('|') Used as Punctuation in /faq Meta Description
Description: The /faq meta description uses a vertical pipe '|' inside a sentence ('Everything you need to know about IncuBrix | getting started, features, pricing...'), which truncates or splits snippets in some search parsers.
Actual Evidence: GET https://incubrix.com/faq -> <meta name="description" content="Everything you need to know about IncuBrix | getting started, features, pricing, brand partnerships, data privacy, and support.">
Recommended Change: Replace the pipe character with an em-dash or colon and include concrete AEO keywords (credit pricing, voice cloning, multi-platform publishing).
Ready-to-Apply Code: <meta name="description" content="Answers to common questions about IncuBrix Creator Studio: getting started, AI clipping, voice cloning, credit pricing, data privacy, and support." />
Validation Method: Verify candidate meta description has 120-160 characters and zero pipe '|' characters.
Validation Result: OPEN ON LIVE SITE: Meta description still contains pipe/grammar issue. | Candidate Patch Check: PASS: Validated meta description (146 chars, pipe-free, grammatically clean).

Title: www.incubrix.com Redirects to Apex incubrix.com — Ensure External Profiles Use Canonical Apex URL
Description: Requests to https://www.incubrix.com/ redirect to https://incubrix.com/ (where canonical tags and sitemap.xml reside). External links pointing to www incur an extra HTTP redirect hop.
Actual Evidence: GET https://www.incubrix.com/ -> Redirects toFINAL_URL: https://incubrix.com/ (canonical='https://incubrix.com/').
Recommended Change: Standardize all directory citations, social profiles, and UTM links to use the canonical apex https://incubrix.com/ URL directly.
Ready-to-Apply Code: <link rel="canonical" href="https://incubrix.com/" />
Validation Method: Verify canonical tag uses https://incubrix.com/ without www.
Validation Result: OPEN ON LIVE SITE: Issue ISS-020 remains open on https://www.incubrix.com/ (awaiting production deploy). | Candidate Patch Check: PASS: Validated apex canonical URL without www.

Title: Duplicated ~20 KB Inline <style> Block Across All 13 HTML Pages Instead of Cached Stylesheet
Description: Each of the 13 pages embeds ~20 KB of identical inline CSS in <head>, preventing browser caching across page navigations and increasing HTML document size to 36 KB–59 KB.
Actual Evidence: Live crawl shows 36,519 to 59,079 bytes per HTML response with inline :root{--bg:#05070D...} CSS duplicated on every route.
Recommended Change: Extract shared styles into a fingerprinted, immutable cached stylesheet (/assets/main.css) with Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable.
Ready-to-Apply Code: <link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/incubrix-core.min.css" />
Validation Method: Verify candidate external stylesheet link syntax is valid.
Validation Result: OPEN ON LIVE SITE: Issue ISS-021 remains open on https://incubrix.com/ (awaiting production deploy). | Candidate Patch Check: PASS: Validated external cacheable stylesheet tag.

Title: Missing Open Graph Locale Tags (og:locale & og:locale:alternate) for US, India, and UK Creator Markets
Description: Pages include basic og:title/og:description/og:url but omit og:locale (en_US) and alternate English locales (en_IN, en_GB) for international creator discovery.
Actual Evidence: GET https://incubrix.com/ -> og_tags has og:title, og:description, og:type, og:image, og:url; og:locale is absent.
Recommended Change: Add og:locale and og:locale:alternate tags for en_US, en_IN, and en_GB.
Ready-to-Apply Code:
<meta property="og:locale" content="en_US" />
<meta property="og:locale:alternate" content="en_IN" />
<meta property="og:locale:alternate" content="en_GB" />
Validation Method: Verify candidate metadata contains og:locale='en_US' and alternates for en_IN and en_GB.
Validation Result: OPEN ON LIVE SITE: Issue ISS-022 remains open on https://incubrix.com/ (awaiting production deploy). | Candidate Patch Check: PASS: Validated og:locale tags for US, India, and UK markets.
